thag5.7:1.1: Pāto majjhantikaṃ sāyaṃ tikkhattuṃ divasass' ahaṃ otariṃ udakaṃ sotaṃ Gayāya Gayaphagguyā. || ||
thag5.7:2.1: yaṃ mayā pakataṃ pāpaṃ pubbe aññāsu jātisu tan dānīdha pavāhemi: evaṃdiṭṭhi pure ahuṃ. || ||
thag5.7:3.1: sutvā subhāsitaṃ vācaṃ dhammatthasahitaṃ padaṃ tathaṃ yathāvakaṃ atthaṃ yoniso paccavekkhisaṃ. || ||
thag5.7:4.1: ninhātasabbapāpo 'mhi nimmalo payato suci suddho suddhassa dāyādo putto buddhassa oraso. || ||
thag5.7:5.1: ogayh' aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ sotaṃ sabbapāpaṃ pavāhayiṃ, tisso vijjā ajjhagamiṃ, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan ti. || || Gayākassapo thero.
